newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt buys 110,000 tonnes wheat for June shipment.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys 110,000 tonnes wheat for June shipment.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company bought 110,000 tonnes of U.S. or Australian wheat on Thursday at about $167 a tonne, traders said.
The wheat is for shipment between June 1 and 10.
The company bought 55,000 tonnes from Finagrain and 55,000 tonnes from Tradigrain. The origin is supplier's option but a trader said it would certainly be U.S.
He said the price was either $166.85 or $166.65 a tonne C+F.
Consolidated Physical Commodities in Geneva said one cargo was at $166.85 and one at $166.50.
